newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City, Kan., suburb votes $78 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City, Kan., suburb votes $78 mln bond issue.

text.p: Councilmembers for a southwest suburb of Kansas City, Kan., have approved $78 million of industrial revenue bonds for a new Allied Signal Commercial Avionics Systems headquarters, the assistant city manager said Wednesday.

Olathe City Council members voted 7-0 Tuesday night to approve the issuance of debt for a new Allied Signal headquarters, which will also receive $19 million of property tax breaks, Assistant City Manager Susan Sherman said.
The aircraft equipment manufacturer plans a 520,000 square foot manufacturing and administrative office facility to replace its current Olathe facility.
Allied Signal will receive a 100 percent property tax abatement for the first five years at the site and a 50 percent abatement for the following five years.
The bonds are to be sold in two series, according to City Manager Michael McCurdy.
